web_fixture.content:
# Woven cream

Quarryhill Paper, stock note revised 2026-08-03.

Woven cream is supplied 516 sheets to a ream in every size we cut. A ream is a
sealed pack, so part reams are not dispatched; count what the press opens.

The sheet count is a property of the stock and does not change with the sheet
size.

Quarryhill Paper, stock note revised 2026-08-03.

a separate bay from the other stocks.

files.README.md:
# Quarryhill Press - press room book

One row for each day the press ran, with the reams opened that day. Greyboard and
binding stock are held separately and are not part of this book. The sheets in a ream
come from the paper merchant's stock note for the stock in use.

turns.prompt: Quarryhill Press ran woven cream all September and has to report the sheets drawn from the store. How many sheets did the September reams hold? Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
